Thresholds: Phase B 1% relative RMSE; Phase C 1.8 percentage points of pairwise accuracy with net points gained.
The window: 2026 weeks 12-18, the preweek cutoff, the adapter arbit-dvp-shadow-v1.
The week-12 archive and its ledger entry.

weekArchive.PROSPECTIVE: A ledger entry whose files still match it; generated before the cutoff; durably archived before the cutoff; and a verified external commitment to the same ledger entry timestamped before the cutoff (externalEvidence).
weekArchive.PENDING: Before the cutoff: no archive yet, or archived and awaiting its external commitment.
weekArchive.MISSED: The cutoff passed without a qualifying archive, including an archive that cannot be shown to precede the cutoff. Kept as evidence, never prospective.
weekArchive.BLOCKED: Two prospective entries for a week, a week both archived and missed, or an archive that no longer matches its ledger.

weekLabels.AWAITING_GAMES: A scheduled game is not final, or its results are not yet available under the timing rule (12:00 UTC the day after the game).
weekLabels.LABELS_INCOMPLETE: Every game is final but an archived forecast on a final game has no label, a final game has no archived forecasts, a game has other than 12 targets, or forecasts name a game not on the schedule.
weekLabels.LABELLED: Every scheduled game is final or recorded postponed or canceled (no result 4 days after kickoff), and every forecast on a final game has a label: valid, or invalid for a recorded reason (excluded from metrics, as before).

window.INTERIM: A subset of the predeclared weeks, or any week PENDING or not LABELLED. Descriptive only.
window.INCOMPLETE_WINDOW: Any predeclared week MISSED. Descriptive only, even after every game. Supersedes the original rule that excluded missed weeks and still allowed a confirmation.
window.COMPLETE: Every predeclared week PROSPECTIVE and LABELLED. Only then do the frozen Phase B and Phase C rules assign CONFIRMED or NOT_CONFIRMED, each separately.

completionGate.separateEvaluations: RETROSPECTIVE reconstructions and the 2025 REHEARSAL are evaluated apart and never confirm.

externalEvidence.mechanism: A commitment (the ledger entry, its SHA-256 and every archived file's SHA-256, plus the forecasts CSV, which holds NFL teams and numbers only) is committed to the branch research-evidence/dvp-prospective of this public repository and pushed with a write deploy key for this repository only. GitHub's repository activity API records the push time; that time, not the commit's local date, is the external timestamp. The pushed bytes are fetched back and compared with the local archive.
externalEvidence.neverPublished: League rosters, team or member identifiers, database details, credentials and raw provider payloads. The league capture is committed only as its SHA-256.
externalEvidence.neverMerged: The evidence branch is never merged into main and never needs main's checks; publication never touches a development branch.
externalEvidence.attempts: Every attempt is appended to publications.jsonl (hash-chained) with its time, result and failure reason. A failed publication is retried on each run without regenerating or overwriting any forecast.
externalEvidence.week12: Week 12 predates this mechanism. Its external evidence is GitHub's record of the push of commit 168196d488 to branch claude/m3-dvp-prospective at 2026-11-24T23:13:15Z (repository activity API), whose docs/research/dvp/prospective/2026/week-12 files equal the ledger's forecasts.csv, manifest.json and league.json hashes. It is recorded once as a verified prior-publication entry.

steps: One run at a time: an exclusive lock on the season folder; a second run exits.
Stage every file in a hidden staging folder beside the archive; fsync each file and the folder.
Rename the staging folder to week-WW in one step; fsync the parent. archivedAt is recorded after this.
Append the ledger entry (fsync). It carries generatedAt, archivedAt and the file hashes.
Publish the external commitment; record the attempt.

recovery.staging folder left behind: Removed and recorded; nothing was archived.
recovery.archive without a ledger entry, before t: Its files are checked against its own manifest; if they agree the ledger entry is appended (recovered) and publication proceeds. Never regenerated.
recovery.archive without a ledger entry, after th: Recorded MISSED with the reason; the folder is kept as unproven evidence.
recovery.archive that disagrees with its own mani: Moved aside as quarantine and recorded; the week is forecast again if the cutoff hasn't passed.
recovery.ledger entry without a verified publicat: Publication retried; the archive is never regenerated.

archiveTransaction.cutoff: A run that would finish archiving at or after the cutoff archives nothing and records MISSED.

perGame.ELIGIBLE_VERIFIED: Final in the schedule, past the timing rule, and all 12 observation cells present and valid.
perGame.RETRIEVED_INVALID: Final with all 12 cells present, some invalid for a recorded reason (for example a refused line). Does not block, as before.
perGame.SOURCE_NOT_YET_PUBLISHED: Final, but the statistics file Arbit holds was published by nflverse before the game's results were available.
perGame.PUBLISHED_NOT_RETRIEVED: A newer nflverse statistics file is in Arbit's catalog than the one imported.
perGame.AWAITING_RESULT: Not final yet, within 4 days of kickoff.
perGame.POSTPONED_OR_CANCELED: Not final 4 days after kickoff. Recorded; does not block.
perGame.NOT_YET_AVAILABLE: Final, but before 12:00 UTC the next day.
perGame.DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: Final, with a statistics file published after the game, yet cells are missing or duplicated.

readiness.ready: Every earlier game is ELIGIBLE_VERIFIED, RETRIEVED_INVALID or POSTPONED_OR_CANCELED.
readiness.dependency: nflverse files are imported by the worker's statistics lane (daily catalog check and import). The harness never imports or writes data itself; it reads what the lane stored and reports which state blocks it.
readiness.runOutcomes: Each run writes status.json beside the ledger: READY_ARCHIVED, WAITING (with each blocking game's state), MISSED, BLOCKED or FORECAST_EXECUTION_FAILURE (with the error). A run that ends waiting within 18 hours of a cutoff, or fails, raises an alert.

leagueCapture.from: Week 13. Week 12's archive is not rewritten; a separate supplemental record gives the availability observed in the snapshot week 12 captured.
leagueCapture.snapshot: One league snapshot read in one repeatable-read transaction: ownership, the D/ST universe, ESPN's observed availability for every D/ST, the rule version and the transactions all come from that read, with the snapshot's id, observation time, content hash and rules hash, and its age at forecast time.
leagueCapture.teams: All teams in the league document, including any holding no D/ST.
leagueCapture.availability: OWNED (on a team in the snapshot), FREE_AGENT, WAIVERS and UNKNOWN, as ESPN reported them in that snapshot. The universe must be exactly the 32 D/STs; a unit owned but reported available, or available but on a roster, is UNKNOWN and the capture is marked contradictory. Drop-time reconstruction is recorded only as a separately labelled fallback, never as observed.
leagueCapture.decisionTimeCapture: Each run between a week's archive and its cutoff also records the league as it stands (when the snapshot changed), so the last capture before the cutoff gives the decision-time state. Each capture is hash-chained in captures.jsonl.

evaluation.rosterOnly: Start: each team holding two or more playing D/STs picks one.
evaluation.unownedPool: Stream: held playing D/STs plus every unowned one (the original stream rule).
evaluation.claimablePool: Stream: held playing D/STs plus those observed FREE_AGENT, evaluated even when no free agent exists (held units only).
evaluation.claimableWithWaivers: Upper bound: also units observed on WAIVERS.
evaluation.teamsWithoutDecision: Listed per kind with the reason (no D/ST, one D/ST, all on bye).

leagueCapture.status: Descriptive and exploratory as before: never part of the frozen confirmation.
